reply_text:
I've saved Ilse's preference and replied to them in their DM. The note says they use Bay 30 for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups from 2026-10-14 on, replacing any earlier bay. My reply in the DM: "Got it, Ilse. I've saved Bay 30 as your dock for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups from now on."

Who can see the note: the memory tool saved it with "world" visibility, so other people who use it may be able to look it up. That's a problem because it came from a private DM, and private DMs shouldn't reach other members. The detail itself isn't sensitive. If it should stay private to Ilse, it needs to be re-saved privately or removed.

Two smaller things:
- **Search was limited.** Before saving, I checked for an existing dock preference for Ilse and found none. That search only matched exact keywords, so an older note worded differently could still exist.
- **First reply failed.** Sending to the DM's channel id as a direct message failed with "no member DH10RUL0001", so I posted the reply into the DM conversation instead.
